scope: Retrospective fixed-photo-reference diagnostic on saved original-static 3D render embeddings only; no new inference or identity qualification

reference.source: Exact development_candidate_threshold from the frozen original-photograph identity-calibration report
reference.interpretation: Descriptive reference only; quality_threshold remains null; no threshold curve, selection, retuning or render calibration

cohort.sources: All known N0 development bridge sources, each a distinct identity; exact source-reset input pin matches the N0 original photo and saved photo feature record
cohort.renders: Only original_static_3d baseline frames with null target_age; one per source and configuration, bound to the frozen capture asset and frame
cohort.exclusions: All SAM target frames and original frames of the two external sources are excluded; held-out source paths or hashes are rejected in every record role
cohort.observed_inventory: Eight sources x eight configurations gives 64 render frames and 512 comparisons; saved frame failures remain in every associated requested pair

statistics.positive: Each render versus its exact source photo is one same-identity pair
statistics.negative: Each render versus every other source identity photo is a directed different-identity pair; reverse directions remain distinct and no self-identity negative is created
statistics.units: One positive unit per identity and one negative unit per ordered render-identity/photo-identity pair within each configuration
statistics.summaries: Eight configurations separately; positive conditional FNMR and negative conditional FMR, requested/scored/failed, false decisions, eligible/effective units and missing-outcome lower/upper bounds
statistics.missing_bounds: Within each requested unit use false/scored for conditional error when scored>0; lower=false/requested, upper=(false+failed)/requested; all-failed units have null conditional and [0,1] bounds; zero-request class has null bounds
statistics.pooling: Never pool eight views as independent subjects or report a new population-level acceptance score

bootstrap.draws: All eligible subject IDs sorted lexicographically, including failed renders; n calls to random.Random(stratum_seed).randrange(n) per replicate, with replacement
bootstrap.weights: Positive unit weight=m_i; directed negative pair(i,j) weight=m_i*m_j for i!=j; copies of the same identity never form new impostor pairs
bootstrap.nulls: The same identity draw is shared across all metrics; retain null when no effective or eligible units remain; never redraw or discard the replicate
bootstrap.interval: Percentile 2.5/97.5 of non-null values using sorted linear interpolation at (N-1)*q; report valid/null counts and null interval when no values exist
bootstrap.digest: SHA256 of the entire ordered 1000-value nullable array encoded by UTF8 json.dumps(separators=(',', ':'),allow_nan=False), no newline
bootstrap.limitations: Conditional descriptive uncertainty for these exposed source identities at one fixed photo reference; not threshold-fitting uncertainty, missingness correction, simultaneous intervals or independent validation

integrity.closed_inputs: Exactly nine selected JSON metadata roles and CLI/test/local standard-library helper source pins; no recursive image/GLB/model reads
integrity.bindings: Prior reference/render verification receipts, photo/reference/N0 links, render/capture/reset/N0 links, reset source to original photo, and selected capture frame/image/observed/source-check consistency
integrity.model: Photo and render model pins and environment must match exactly; successful embeddings are finite nonzero 128-dimensional vectors, failures retain null
integrity.publication: Bounded reads at declared length+1, loaded source hash checks, final input/plan/runtime rechecks after computation and serialization; atomic fresh output only

observations: Original-photo scores, source textures and old render-domain results have already been viewed; the eight source photos belong to the reference's development cohort.
The saved render cohort is the 2026-10-23 SwiftShader/old-viewer capture, not the current viewer, ordinary GPU configuration or stable-browser real-service acceptance.

This measures rendering, pose, alpha/material, coverage and detection confounds; generated-image identity, human appearance approval, independent data, training overlap and allowed uses remain unresolved.
